argument: Agree with the setup from a macro perspective. Oil S/D balance is tightening — OPEC compliance at 96%, US shale growth decelerating, China imports +4% YoY. WTI at $82 is supportive for E&P margins without triggering Fed hawkishness. XLE/RSP ratio at 0.2712 (z-score 0.63) shows energy still cheap vs broad market historically. Only concern: DXY has been strengthening — if dollar rally accelerates, commodities face headwind. But for a hedged single-name trade, this is less relevant.
